reason: Windows integration corrects three Mac Cmd bindings in explicitly Windows VS Code/Proto.io keymaps, removes five falsely Windows-labelled Xcode rows and six Zoom iOS rows incorrectly exported to desktop platforms, and corrects two inherited Gmail bindings in both Mac and Windows keymaps: minus marks not important and q searches chat. Saved shortcut references to those sixteen old bindings become unavailable; users can re-favorite or recreate overlays against the corrected rows. Existing macOS keymaps remain except these two Gmail corrections. No automatic label-based migration or private-data mutation is performed.

Removes three exact duplicate rows (Photoshop 'Rotate View tool' r in Default and Default (Windows) Select tools; Firefox 'Focus Address Bar' f6 in Default Miscellaneous). Only the second occurrence is removed; the identical first row (occurrence 0) remains, so users keep the same shortcut and can re-favorite it. Saved references to the removed second occurrence become unavailable; no automatic migration or private-data mutation is performed.

Corrects eight Things Default bindings against Cultured Code's official Mac shortcut list (issue #151): Move complete to Logbook cmd+l -> shift+cmd+y, Start Someday cmd+q -> cmd+o, Deadline -1 day ctrl -> ctrl+, (the comma had been dropped), Show to-do or project in context shift+cmd+l -> cmd+l, Enter a selected project right -> cmd+right, Return to previous list left -> cmd+left, and Scroll to top/bottom opt+up/opt+down -> home/end (fn+left/right; opt+up/down are Select first/last, added as new rows). Saved references to the eight old rows become unavailable; users can re-favorite or recreate overlays against the corrected rows. No automatic label-based migration or private-data mutation is performed.
